title: ChatGPT may Pass the Bar Exam soon, but has a Long Way to Go for the LexGLUE benchmark
reasoning: The paper evaluates ChatGPT's performance on legal text classification tasks. While legal tasks inherently deal with principles of justice and law, the paper's evaluation focuses on classification accuracy and does not benchmark the model's understanding or reasoning regarding abstract morals, ethics, or faith. The brief mention of 'ethical considerations' in the context of prompt engineering limitations does not qualify.
